desc: Ideation: select index sqrt decomposition with precomputed element-vs-opposite-block-prefix tables.
Implement input parsing, dynamic block count M/S, sorted A/B by value, sorted block values/sums, and block-id arrays.
Build PA rows (array('q') length N) where PA[y][i] is sum over first y B blocks, using per-B-block two-pointer over sorted A and a cumulative list; accumulate H[a_block][b_block].
Build PB rows symmetrically where PB[x][j] is sum over first x A blocks, using per-A-block two-pointer over sorted B.
Build G 2D prefix from H, then for each query compute xb,yb, remainders, add table prefix sums and remainder-remainder via direct small product or sorted two-pointer merge, and print answers.
